name: Macaques!
summary:
Hello! It is the creator here, AlbinoGT!

Me and Beach have teamed up to create this Gorilla Tag fangame, known as Macaques! We have a lot to offer, including a Glass Bridge gamemode, lots of cosmetics, and horror! It would be cool if you downloaded the game, since we have worked very hard nonstop for 2 months. We even had to remake the game! Hopefully you will enjoy our game!

- AlbinoGT and Beach
